summary: Tested the new CSR Partners page, redesigned Contact page, About page collage, Donate header alignment, and Navbar CSR link. Backend POST /api/submissions verified (200) for both kind=csr and kind=volunteer via UI. All data-testids present. One design deviation found on About page (photos are 7 per row on 1366px desktop, not 5 per row as requested).

issues: Story photo collage renders 7 tiles per row on desktop (1366px), not the requested 5 per row. Current tile size h-36 w-36 (144px) + gap-3 in a max-w-7xl px-16 container (~1152px usable) fits 7 across. To enforce 5 per row on desktop, either enlarge tiles (~h-52 w-52) or constrain the flex-wrap container width (e.g., max-w-4xl mx-auto), or switch to a fixed grid grid-cols-5. Tiles themselves are equal-size, centered and not distorted.

action_items: About/OUR STORY: adjust the story-collage so exactly 5 tiles fit per row on desktop (>=1024px). Options: use `grid grid-cols-5 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 max-w-3xl mx-auto` OR increase tile size to ~h-52 w-52 with `max-w-4xl mx-auto` on the flex-wrap container. Current implementation places 7 per row on 1366px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: CsrForm and Contact form share nearly identical input styling and success panel logic — consider extracting a shared FormShell component to reduce duplication.

Contact page passes topic.kind='csr' for the Partnership option in the on-page form; this is intentional but the new CSR Partners page now handles CSR submissions — consider hiding the 'Partner / Donate' topic on the contact form or updating its hint to redirect to /csr-partners to avoid split intake channels.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test submissions in MongoDB via UI (kind=csr TEST_Org and kind=volunteer TEST_Vol) and 1 via curl (kind=csr TEST_bt). All prefixed with TEST_ for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSR Partners page, Contact redesign, Donate header left-align, Navbar CSR link are all confirmed working. Only pending fix: About story-collage should show 5 tiles per row on desktop (currently 7).
rca of the issue: About collage uses `flex flex-wrap justify-center` with tiles fixed at h-36 w-36 (144px) and gap-3 (12px) inside max-w-7xl container with px-16. Usable width ~1152px / (144+12) = 7.4 → 7 tiles per row. To hit 5, either constrain container to ~max-w-3xl or use grid-cols-5.
